summary: All 3 blocking findings are valid and should be applied in spec-repair.

items.title: Freshness proof does not cover same-path changes
items.rationale: The current R1 path/source check can miss same-path content or command source changes after test-execute. The spec must require immutable diff/content fingerprints and full command identity before reuse.
items.evidence: spec-review.json blockingFindings[0]; spec.json requirements[0].desc currently checks command/source and path membership only.

items.title: Risk skip relies on an unsafe non-runtime boundary
items.rationale: The risk-based skip rule needs an explicit allowlist and must treat all non-allowlisted paths as trigger-relevant full-regression inputs.
items.evidence: spec-review.json blockingFindings[1]; existing `classifyRegression()` can classify unanalysed text-like non-doc files as `non-project-only`.

items.title: Completion contract path is omitted for skipped results
items.rationale: The final-regression completion path includes flow-judgment-contract policy in addition to registry post-hook validation, so R4/T2 must include that retained surface.
items.evidence: spec-review.json blockingFindings[2]; `tryUpdateStepStatus` uses completion contracts before a step can be marked done.
